# Gain Strength Therapy

> Gain Strength Therapy is a specialist small-group strength training studio in
> Eastbourne, East Sussex (UK). It is built for people who find ordinary gyms
> intimidating — complete beginners, adults over 40, older adults, people
> progressing after physiotherapy, and people rebuilding strength after injury,
> surgery, or illness. Sessions are capped at six members and led by founder
> Hallum Cousins (MSc Sport Physiology). The studio holds a 5.0-star Google
> rating.

## Key facts

- Business name: Gain Strength Therapy
- Type: Small-group strength training studio / personal training
- Location: Dursley Rd, Eastbourne, BN22 8DJ, United Kingdom
- Area served: Eastbourne and East Sussex
- Phone: +44 1323 370022
- Founder & head coach: Hallum Cousins — MSc Sport Physiology (University of
  Brighton), BSc Sports Science (University of Bath)
- Session size: maximum 6 people per session
- Who it is for: beginners, over-40s and older adults, post-physio clients, and
  people managing conditions such as chronic back pain, type 2 diabetes,
  osteoarthritis, osteoporosis, and long COVID
- Not a substitute for medical advice; clients with conditions are advised to
  consult their GP before starting

## Programmes

- 6-Week Strength Programme: an entry block to learn the core lifts, build the
  habit, and see measurable strength gains. Two phases over six weeks, no
  contract afterwards. https://www.gainstrengththerapy.com/6-week
- 12-Week Transformation: a deeper, three-phase programme for bigger, lasting
  strength change and the best value per session.
- Ongoing membership: rolling monthly, no fixed contract, available after a
  programme finishes.

Request a free consultation (no more than 30 minutes, by phone or in person)
via the contact page, or call +44 1323 370022.
